title: docs(pm-dispatch): read a PR's live state before any report to the maintainer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9PhMQ8uCJ2gFAvwHUAJPEcW)_
Fixes #26675
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：pm-dispatch 协调者手册第七节，向你汇报任何 PR 状态前，必须当场重读 merged、draft、auto_merge、是否在队、reviews 与 mergeable_state。
- 为什么改：今天两次把你已处理（已批、已 ready 入队）的 PR 仍报成「等你」；旧规则只要求读 mergeable_state，且只管「无需你做」一个方向。
- 风险与回滚：只改一份内部技能文档的两行，不发布、不影响运行时；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md` 第七节末两行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`，预期两条都绿、该文件仍 49 行。
- 需要你做的：总监契约复审 PASS 后，在 GitHub 上批准或直接 ready 入队（Tier S；席位自己 ready 会被权限拦下）。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md` section 7 (read by the coordinator and every seat thread):

- The relay line that named only `mergeable_state`, and only before relaying "no action needed", is replaced by two lines that cover every PR state reported to the maintainer, both directions: before any report, re-read in the same act `merged`, `draft`, `auto_merge`, queue membership, reviews and `mergeable_state`; a PR can be readied and queued with no APPROVED review, so reviews alone is not the reading; a PR whose ask is already met is dropped; `dirty` still sends it back to the thread to merge main.
- Paid for by deleting the when-to-report line (only results, blockers or pending decisions; routine progress to the thread checklist). Its surviving homes: SKILL.md's push-the-maintainer pair (what is pushed; routine progress is not) and `seat-lifecycle.md`'s "round report = card-thread checklist". The line itself said "same rule as the seats".
- Queue membership is named, not spelled out: its reading already lives in `platform-readings.md` (queue ref, positive probes, timeline enqueue event). No second copy in SKILL.md.

Maintainer, verbatim: 「这几个pr 都处理过了，你的消息不及时，如何优化」「是否建议更新到 pm-dispatch skills ，你会阅读那个吗」

Line budget: `coordinator.md` 49 → 49 (ceiling 49, +2 / −2); both new lines 118 bytes (cap 120); no untouched line re-wrapped. No forced test edits.

## Tests

None: prose-only change to a repo-internal agent playbook. No changeset (`.claude`-only diff, `skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks for the rule "stated once in section 7": it is, and SKILL.md is untouched.
- Deleting the when-to-report line is a judgment call to keep the line count flat; the alternative cut was the language line (homes: AGENTS.md Communication and SKILL.md's all-seat invariant). The seat may swap.
